name: saturation
title: F. Saturation test
description: Concurrency is increased geometrically (stage length fixed) until a stop condition: error rate, p99 latency, throughput plateau, host CPU or a generator-saturation warning. Reports the highest tested configuration that met the stability criteria and the first that did not. The background backlog is reported per stage but is not a stop condition (the workers have separate capacity). A single stable stage is not a capacity claim.
